- Scrum master

positions.title: Product Development Engineer - Software
positions.description:
Lead embedded software developer for the M81 Synchronous Source Measure System. Responsible for making embedded software architecture design decisions, implementing embedded software features (C++), and testing software through HIL (hardware in the loop) tests and unit tests.

Part of an agile software development team using Scrum framework with biweekly sprints. Experience using version control with Git.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · Scrum · Agile · C++

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed embedded software for a flight software baseline (C++) in a Linux environment. Responsibilities included implementing embedded software features, integrating and testing software (Python and Ruby test scripts), and debugging software at a system level with cross-functional teams 

Served as Lab Manager of a research and development laboratory. Responsibilities included planning projects, leading the software development team, serving as Scrum Master, managing subcontractors, and presenting lab projects to stakeholders. Software skills used in this role: MQTT, Azure (VMs, container registries), Docker, Kubernetes, C++, networking protocols (TCP, UDP), OpenC3.

Served as Functional Manager for five engineers in the software department. Responsibilities included providing career mentorship, giving performance reviews, and setting annual goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · Docker · Strategic Planning · Scrum · Agile · Ruby · C++ · Embedded Linux

positions.title: Product Development Engineer (Software)
positions.description:
Embedded software development in C++ and C. Experience writing software for various  communication protocols (i2c, SPI, UART, USART). Responsible for testing instrumentation software by writing Python testing scripts and C++ embedded unit testing. Experience troubleshooting hardware and software using tools such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and waveform generators. 

Projects include:
M91 Fast Hall Controller
F71/F41 Teslameter
155 Precision Voltage/Current Source

Part of an agile software development team using Scrum framework with biweekly sprints. Experience using version control with Git.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · Scrum · Agile · C++

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
Created control panel layouts using AutoCAD electrical.  Analyzed wire diagrams and schematics to create detailed wiring charts used by production workers to make control panel wiring and manufacturing easier.

Improved manufacturing processes for cable assemblies by creating custom test adapters for quality and continuity checks of cable assemblies. This included adapters that test for proper sensing of cables that contain proximity sensors. 

Responsible for frequent communication with customers. These experiences included:
- Analyzing and verifying schematics and wiring diagrams supplied by customers
- Sending requests for wiring revisions
- Creating models in excel for engineering quoting

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for answering questions during lab sessions and grading lab reports for a sophomore year electrical and computer engineering class.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Wrote a program using C++ and network programming using Boost Libraries that managed test programs submitted to the batch-queuing system by systems engineers. This program was responsible for accepting incoming batches of test programs, monitoring their progress, and terminating them if they stopped responding. TCP/IP protocol was used.

Wrote Matlab programs related to Digital Signal Processing and Digital Communications. These projects were related to the following topics:
-Filter Design (IIR and FIR)
-LMS equalizers
-Lowering Signal-to-Noise ratio in communication channels

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Worked with one of my professors on one of his medical imaging research projects related to magnetic resonance coil images. I was responsible for programming an adaptive filtering program to maximize sound-to-noise ratio of medical images.

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a project to improve process efficiency on the packaging lines in order to meet corporate’s target. I led communication efforts, created incentive programs, and improved planning numbers for package types.

Attended several training courses related to the manufacturing equipment used in the brewery, which included:
-  Training on how the laser coders used in the brewery work and how to troubleshoot them.
- Training for safety control systems used on the equipment in the brewery which was focused on PLC programming with RSLogix.

positions.title: Capital Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Engaged in the startup of large capital projects around the brewery. My responsibilities included included attending weekly planning meetings with interdisciplinary departments and developing standardized tools to execute field cost administration duties.

Attended formal training classes for new assembly line equipment. After attending these courses, I was responsible for writing operating procedures that the operators would use.
